description: List connected integrations (Stripe, Shopify, Supabase, Clerk, WooCommerce, ad platforms, and so on) with connection status, sync state, last sync time, and last sync error. Read-only: credentials, access tokens, and webhook secrets are never returned. Use this to audit which external systems feed this account and whether their syncs are healthy.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

includeInactive.description: Include disconnected/inactive integrations. Defaults to false (active only).

name: list_integrations

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_integrations` MCP tool.

integrations.description: List of connected integration, including provider, provider account ID, active and sync status, last sync time, last sync error, allowlisted non-secret details, cohorts (Mixpanel and Amplitude: each synced cohort's id, name, and tag), eventSettings (Amplitude), and lastSyncSkipped (records the last sync could not import normally: suppressed profiles that cannot receive email, plus any that were not imported). Credentials are never included records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
